normalization: GPEDC 0..1 times 100; D2_6_1 divide by 5 then times 100
missing: require all selected indicators; never substitute other-source proxies
grade_policy: 12 equal-width display bins, provisional only; not empirical thresholds
freshness: Separate edition year and observed reporting periods; country_ratings.json contains observed_periods; old editions never silently backfilled

chemistry.gate: all four components; >=3 independent evaluated projects in same sector, >=2 completion years; coverage and selection bias shown; proposed quality gate, not statistical guarantee
chemistry.current_preview: DFAT health effectiveness distributions are descriptive evidence, not chemistry

scope: multi-donor and multi-recipient; 10 donor and 24 recipient demo scope; eventual open-ended coverage
source_reuse: allowed across views and constructs with explicit lineage; same observation not double weighted
agency_country_mapping: retain agency identity; no blind country attribution of agency score
comparison: criterion-oriented scores + optional peer percentile, never enforced equal-size grade groups
country_role_inputs: See source raw indicator IDs retained in country_ratings.json
financial_total_status: transactions preserved; cross-source national totals not yet reconciled
